thread:
elaine: Partner 'Lyra' onboarding flapping: SCIM user creates 400 MissingAttribute(role) and a few KMS decrypt errors. Opening thread.
peter: Seen this 05:11 UTC. Any recent changes on our side?
chantal: No deploys. Lyra says they upgraded their SAML templating library yesterday.
kms-bot: [05:12:03] kms.decrypt error key=lyra/extid reason=InvalidEnvelopeHeader id=req_b1f3
peter: Pulled sample SAML assertion: attributes present but prefix changed to 'ns2:'. Eg: ``<ns2:Attribute Name="urn:redwood:attr:role"><ns2:AttributeValue>ops</ns2:AttributeValue></ns2:Attribute>``
elaine: Our mapping used a brittle prefix check. We should match by namespace URI, not prefix.
chantal: Short fix: enable tenant-level tolerant parsing for Lyra. I can flip flag.
ops-oncall: Doing: ``/ops tenant-config lyra scim.ns_relaxed=true --expires 6h``
integrations: Lyra also sent ext_id wrapped using "aws-kms-envelope-v2". They thought v2 was backward compatible. It's not.
peter: We must reject unknown envelopes and return 400 with clear instructions. Meanwhile, log full header to audit so SOC can correlate.
chantal: Agreed. I'll send Lyra a note: please resend wrapped ext_ids using "redwood-kms-v1" and re-push SAML metadata with correct attribute namespaces.
ops-oncall: After flag flip, MissingAttribute failures dropped 12->1 in 8m. KMS decrypt errors unchanged.
kms-bot: [05:40:12] scim.create succeeded user=lyra/j.park req=req_c3d4 note=extid-accepted
peter: Action items: (1) chantal open SEC-2201 parser fix + tests; (2) infra add stricter 400 + audit on unknown envelope SEC-2202; (3) integrations follow up with Lyra and request rewrap/resend.
elaine: I've captured sample artifacts and attached to SEC-2201. We'll revert tenant flag after parser fix lands. Thanks team :thumbsup:
